name: Avena same-unit asking-price index

known_gaps.note: Declared capture gap 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-20. No capture. No index value is published for these days, and no weekly change is filled in for them.

method: Weekly chain of same-unit asking-price changes in the committed listing book. An eligible capture is the last commit of public/data.json in a closed ISO week, Monday to Sunday UTC, on or after 2026-08-05, excluding days inside a declared capture gap. The base is 100 on the first eligible capture. Each later published value is the previous value multiplied by the unweighted geometric mean of asking-price relatives for refs that are the same unit in the same place. The same-unit rule is the Market Pulse unit-identity check: property type, bedrooms and bathrooms equal, and built and plot size within 2%. A specification change is excluded. A change of 25% or more is held back unless that check verifies it: full specs on both sides, the same photo set, a new EUR/m² within the area-benchmark band, and a price that does not return exactly to an earlier asking price of that ref on this weekly series within 365 days. Unchanged asking prices of the same unit stay in the mean. A closed week with no eligible capture is a gap row with no index value. A step whose comparison dates cover a declared capture gap is the change between the two captures that exist. It is not split into the missing days, and those days are not filled in. A cell with fewer matched pairs than its minimum has no index and no breadth share. The pair counts are still published. Figures are asking prices. This is not a transaction price, not the Eurostat house price index, and not the AVENA composite.
caveats: Asking prices of new-build listings. A ref that leaves the book is not a recorded sale.
A ref is a feed reference. On a new-build it is often one unit type in a development, not one dwelling. The match holds the advertised specification fixed. It does not prove a single dwelling.
Each matched ref has equal weight. A higher asking price does not count for more.
A change below 25% is accepted when a specification field is absent on one side. A change of 25% or more is held back when a required spec is missing.
A return to an earlier asking price is judged on earlier captures in this weekly series, within 365 days. It is not a read of every daily snapshot.
The series starts on 2026-08-05, a Wednesday. The base week is not seven days of captures.
Dates inside a declared capture gap have no index value. No week on this series is interpolated.
The published index is the unrounded chain, rounded half away from zero to 2 decimal places. The published weekly change is that week's geometric mean, not the gap between the rounded levels.

definitions.index: Chain of same-unit asking-price relatives. 100 on the segment base date. Blank when the cell is under its matched-pair minimum, or when the week has no capture.
definitions.change_pct: Unweighted geometric mean of this capture's asking price divided by the previous capture's asking price, minus one, in percent, for matched pairs. Blank on the base week, on a gap week, and when the cell is suppressed. Not a daily rate, and not split across missing days.
definitions.matched_pairs: Refs with a positive single asking price on both captures, in the same place for this row, that pass the same-unit check. Includes unchanged prices. Blank on the base week and on a gap week.
definitions.priced_listings: Listings in this cell on the capture date with one positive asking price. A from-to range is not one price.
definitions.cuts: Matched pairs whose asking price fell by at least EUR 1.
definitions.rises: Matched pairs whose asking price rose by at least EUR 1.
definitions.unchanged: Matched pairs whose asking price moved by less than EUR 1.
definitions.cut_share: Cuts divided by matched pairs, half-up to 4 decimal places. Blank when the cell is suppressed or there is no comparison.
definitions.rise_share: Rises divided by matched pairs, on the same terms as the cut share.
definitions.unchanged_share: Unchanged divided by matched pairs, on the same terms as the cut share.
definitions.excluded_spec_change: Refs in both captures, in this place, whose type, bedrooms, bathrooms, built size or plot size disagree. Excluded whether or not the asking price changed. Not a price move.
definitions.held_back_large_move: Refs in both captures, in this place, whose asking price moved by 25% or more and which the unit-identity check could not verify. Excluded.
definitions.reassigned: Coast rows only. Refs present in both captures whose town or province changed. Not a price move.
definitions.excluded_unpriced: Refs in both captures, in this place, with no positive asking price on at least one side.
definitions.excluded_price_range: Refs in both captures, in this place, where either capture advertises a from-to range rather than one asking price.
definitions.spans_declared_capture_gap: True when the days between the two captures include a declared capture gap. The index steps once, by the observed matched-pair change. The missing days have no value.
definitions.suppressed: True when matched pairs are under the minimum for this level. The index and the shares are blank. The counts are the counted pairs.
